prompt: What is the name of the play written in May 2016 by a playwright who won the MacArthur Fellowship the same year as the poet who wrote "Postcolonial Love Poem"?
answer: The play is **_Pipeline_**, written by **Dominique Morisseau** in May 2016. Morisseau received a MacArthur Fellowship in 2018, the same year as poet **Natalie Diaz**, author of _Postcolonial Love Poem_.
